assessment_start: 2026-09-14 (stage began after the scan gate passed; precise start not recorded)

searches_used.note: WebFetch calls are not WebSearch calls and are not counted against the cap. No prior-cycle search was reused as new evidence.

results.name: France
results.key_finding: YEAR ERROR: the scanner's 'Bloquons tout' protest evidence (200,000 protesters, 500+ arrests) is from September 2025. The only in-window item is France's 13 September retraction of a human-rights criticism under US pressure. Measured 52.5 (-10.0, band crossing) but WITHHELD: the band-crossing evidence test fails and most of the gap is 62.5-placeholder calibration.

results.name: Slovenia
results.key_finding: The new government scrapped its predecessor's arms embargo and settlement-import ban, and opened Israel's first EU embassy in-window. Measured 58.7 (-3.8) crosses Established to Functional but is WITHHELD: no tier-4 source, about half the move is integer-grid rounding of the 62.5 placeholder, and EDRi's strongest items are plans, not enacted laws.

results.name: Bolivia
results.key_finding: The US$35M central-bank intervention (9 Sept) is an economic response, not new rights conduct. Measured 5.0 vs 6.3 is grid rounding. The scan's '76% loss' is arithmetically inconsistent with its own 6.96 to 9.73 rates (about 28.5%). Baseline set by four applied conduct downgrades; a July upgrade was rejected; calibration flag carried.

results.name: Brazil
results.key_finding: The Supreme Court crisis is real, but its graft and surveillance claims are unproven allegations and are not scored as findings. The scanner's cited Al Jazeera source did not contain the police-chief removal and reinstatement; confirmed via AFP. Measured 33.7 vs 35.9 is grid rounding.

results.name: Syria
results.key_finding: FLOOR CONFIRM at 0.0 with zero downward room. A search-synthesis claim of security forces firing live ammunition is in NONE of four fetched articles and was excluded. Scan corrections: announcement 12-13 Sept (not 14), protest cities, Kobani and the UNDP attribution not in source.

results.name: Nepal
results.key_finding: Death toll 1,386 verified (NDRRMA via Akashvani, 13 Sept). In-window: official SMS alerts arrived with the flood, in Nepali only, and a post-2021-disaster recommendation for binding forecast-to-action rules remains unimplemented. Large relief effort credited. Measured 43.8 (-4.6), second consecutive below published; watch escalated. Scan overstated 'no warning system existed'.

results.name: Cabo Verde
results.key_finding: State response to the deadliest road crash in the country's history was prompt and investigation-led: national mourning, PM and President on Fogo the next day, a 16-member medical unit, and a Council of Ministers inquiry team (10 Sept) covering road construction and inspection. Confirmed. Duplicate 'Cape Verde' row NOT assessed; recorded for founder decision.

results.name: Jamaica
results.key_finding: Currency verified as JMD: J$1.05bn (US$6.6M) for 268 semi-permanent homes, with beneficiaries verified by the Ministry of Labour and Social Security. Real but small against about 24,000 destroyed homes. Two up-moves offset grid rounding; confirmed at 37.5.

results.name: Liechtenstein
results.key_finding: DATE ERROR: the beneficial-ownership register breach was 29/30 July, not 8 September; the response (system offline, disclosure within four days) is credited as background. The 13-12 abortion vote is scored neutrally. Confirmed at 83.0; the Exemplary label rests on a 5-country placeholder, flagged for cohort study.

results.name: Uruguay
results.key_finding: The in-window 10-year, multi-party National Security Plan ('democratic, republican and participatory') supports existing high anchors. Amnesty's 2025 prison findings move one Equity subdimension down. Confirmed at 83.0 (measured 81.8); an Exemplary placeholder shared by 5 countries is flagged for cohort study.

results.name: Portugal
results.key_finding: Baseline verified as applied 2026-08-16 on the face-covering ban. The in-window €1.5bn EIB social-housing loan (€500M first tranche for municipal Local Housing Strategies, vulnerable families) moves Proportionality up. Confirmed at 60.6 (measured 61.2); the ban's 18 August promulgation is not re-scored.

results.name: Hong Kong
results.key_finding: PROPOSAL (downgrade 32.8 to 26.9, -5.9, no band change). In-window: three Tiananmen vigil organisers sentenced to 5-7 years for inciting subversion in a case the judges said involved no violence. OHCHR (tier 4) called the sentences regrettable; the HKSAR Government (tier 5) dismissed criticism as smears. Completes the escalation the 2026-07-31 watch flag anticipated.

results.name: Mozambique
results.key_finding: The ISM Niassa attack (3 Sept) is non-state and NOT scored; state protective failure and response are. HRW-documented impunity for about 400 post-election protest killings moves three subdimensions on this first individual assessment. Abductions reconciled (police at least 11; AP up to 20). Confirmed at 23.4 (measured 21.3, 1.3 above Critical).

results.name: Poland
results.key_finding: The 1 September registry cliff edge verified (RFE/RL, UNHCR). Its own source reports a six-month grace-period amendment the scan omitted, credited as correction. Public-opinion figures excluded as non-state. Confirmed at 42.2 (measured 42.5).

results.name: South Korea
results.key_finding: The in-window Seoul Metropolitan Council ordinances (11 Sept, 69-37: restored disability public jobs, mobility as a right, low-floor buses) move Access Design up. The disability protest end was 24 Aug (pre-window). Strike size is membership, not turnout. A 2023 E-9 migrant-worker rule presented as current was rejected. Confirmed at 62.5 (measured 61.9).

results.name: Spain
results.key_finding: MEASURED-NOT-FILED: measured 51.2 (-8.8) corroborates the PENDING spain-2026-08-26 proposal (50.6) within grid noise; no duplicate filed, existing proposal untouched. In-window child protection (no summary deportation of minors, 500-child transfer) moves one subdimension up. The scan's 'plastic bullets and tear gas' is not in its source.

results.name: Boeing
results.key_finding: The in-window fact is DISCLOSURE, not conduct: the US$3.1M FAA fine paid January 2026 surfaced only when the FAA told Reuters on 2 Sept, and Boeing gave no comment. The FAA's July 2026 restoration of certification authority is credited but not filable (3M precedent). Confirmed at 14.1.

results.name: Los Angeles
results.key_finding: The Oversight subcommittee request (2-3 Sept) and HUD's June suspension are ALLEGATIONS, not findings; nothing is scored as established. The scanner's RedState source was rejected as partisan opinion, and Bass's reported refusal to testify is unverified from a neutral source. Sidecar held; confirmed at 35.9 (measured 34.4), watch carried.

results.name: Indonesia
results.key_finding: YEAR ERROR: the scanner's riot evidence (ojol driver killed 28 Aug, about 10 dead) is August 2025; a second 2025 Papua crackdown surfaced as 2026 in search synthesis. Both excluded, and the Foreign Policy source is unverifiable (403). Papua Q2 2026 impunity moves one subdimension. Confirmed at 35.9 (measured 33.1).
